messages.text:
The Commander II 16" Antique Ocean Floor Globe is a great pick for floor standing — it has a convertible pedestal, so it stands tall on its own base with that warm, antique-map look for a study or living room. If you want something even more striking as a floor centerpiece, the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe adds illumination and a larger hand-crafted hardwood stand.

Is this one for your own space, or a gift?

Lovely choice for a gift — the Commander II has that warm, old-world antique look that reads as a thoughtful, substantial present, and its pedestal stand makes it feel like a real piece of furniture when it arrives assembled and ready to display. You'll find it under that exact name, "Commander II 16" Antique Ocean Floor Globe - Convertible Pedestal," in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.

Who's the lucky recipient — someone who loves maps and travel, or more for their home decor?
